races.verdict: WINSTON'S OATH has upped his game since the visor went on, building on a good second when opening his account in clear-cut fashion back at Fontwell 10 days ago. He appeals as the type to go on improving for his excellent yard and can follow up under Sean Bowen. Dante's Inferno , who is feasibly treated on his penultimate Market Rasen second, and the consistent Ballylicky Bay are others to consider. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE) DANTE'S INFERNO BALLYLICKY BAY (IRE)
